description: Compute a weight-based single dose and daily total from mg/kg — always verify with a pharmacist or doctor.

faqs.a: Weight in kg × prescribed mg per kg. Dosing must come from a clinician or the medicine label — never invent it.
Daily total = single dose × doses per day. It helps you check the label math, not replace it.
This tool does arithmetic only. Wrong inputs or wrong mg/kg values can be dangerous — always verify with a pharmacist or doctor.

howto: Enter the prescribed dose in mg per kg.
Read the single dose and daily total — then VERIFY with a pharmacist or doctor.
title: Medicine Dosage Calculator
